best_narrative.headline: Zocdoc: Competitor Telehealth Lobbying Surge Signals NY Advertising Scrutiny
best_narrative.body: Zocdoc operates a healthcare directory and booking platform with embedded telehealth referral logic, creating exposure to state medical advertising rules and consumer protection enforcement that differs from pure-play telehealth operators focused on prescription delivery. Four competitors filed federal lobbying disclosures on telehealth topics in recent weeks, signaling mobilization around access and economics policy; NY's medical advertising enforcement historically targets directory and referral operators more aggressively than clinical platforms. Industry-standard regulatory exposures for this business model include anti-kickback implications in referral structures and state-level advertising claim substantiation requirements. Material exposure given NY's top-three state status and the directory platform's dependence on consumer-facing referral claims.
